title: Good Vibes
description: visual enhancements, QoL, and fancy world generation + a few structure and adventure mods for extra exploration
body:
A collection of visual and animation enhancements, a few of my favorite QoL mods, some nice shaders, and a handfull of adventure mods for some extra fun all rounded out with a couple fancy world-gen mods to provide interesting terrain to explore.

   this modpack should provide an atmospheric and interesting experience, and includes the Essential mod for easy multiplayer. it's fantasy themed, though mostly sticks to the original vibe of minecraft. it's essentially vanilla+, mostly enhaning the appearence of the game.
